# My GitHub Pages Site\n\nThis repository hosts a simple GitHub Pages site, serving as a collection of various generated files and content. The main `index.html` file acts as a homepage, providing links and descriptions for each component.\n\n## Files Included:\n\n*   **`index.html`**: The main landing page, built with Tailwind CSS, providing navigation and explanations for all other files.\n*   **`ashravan.txt`**: A Brandon Sanderson-inspired short story exploring Ashravan's fate after his restoration by Shai.\n*   **`dilemma.json`**: A JSON file presenting an ethical dilemma for an autonomous vehicle, exploring different scenarios and proposed solutions.\n*   **`about.md`**: A concise description of the author in three words.\n*   **`pelican.svg`**: An SVG image depicting a pelican enjoying a bicycle ride.\n*   **`restaurant.json`**: A JSON file recommending a notable restaurant in Chennai, India, with details on its location and signature dishes.\n*   **`prediction.json`**: A JSON file containing a prediction for the Federal Funds rate by December 2025, along with the reasoning behind it.\n*   **`uid.txt`**: A utility file provided as an attachment, included as-is.\n*   **`LICENSE`**: The MIT License covering the code and content of this repository.\n\nThis project demonstrates the generation and organization of diverse file types within a single web presence.
